canonical_name: Sobolev embedding theorem (supercritical first-order Morrey-Sobolev form)
canonical_statement: Let Omega be a bounded Lipschitz (equivalently, for this scope, a specified W1p extension) domain in R^n, let 1 <= n < p < infinity, and let u belong to W^{1,p}(Omega). Then u has a representative that is Holder continuous on the closure of Omega with exponent alpha = 1 - n/p, and its Holder norm is bounded by a domain-dependent constant times its W^{1,p} norm.

domain_and_universes: n : Nat with 1 <= n; Omega : Set (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n)); p : Real with n < p and p finite; scalar-valued u in W^{1,p}(Omega); Prop in Lean universe 0
quantifiers: u : Sobolev W^{1,p}(Omega) object (exact Lean representation pending)
hypotheses: Omega is bounded and Lipschitz, or carries the precisely specified bounded W^{1,p} extension operator used by the proof
conclusion: There exists a representative u_tilde on closure Omega with Holder exponent alpha = 1 - n/p and ||u_tilde||_{C^{0,alpha}} <= C(Omega,n,p) ||u||_{W^{1,p}}.
